items.description:
##Today##

Sunny intervals and windy. A few isolated showers are possible during the afternoon and evening, becoming more widespread for a time overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 9°C and max. air temperature 13°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0-2


##Wind Speed##

30


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

SW 30-35 with gusts of 40-45, occasionally 50 at first, veering W or SW 25-30 with gusts of 35-40 in the morning, then decreasing 20-25 for a time in the afternoon & evening, increasing 25-30 with gusts of 35-40 again overnight.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.


##Comments##

Gales at first, then strong winds. Risk of coastal overtopping at high tide (~11:35 & 00:05).
